```{r fun-prepare-data}
prepare_data <- function(path) {
  x <- readRDS(path) %>%
    mutate(replicate = as.integer(replicate)) %>%
    arrange(nperm, nSamples, maxSetSize, nSets, alpha, replicate) %>%
    mutate(
      x_pos = (replicate - 2L) * 0.25 + alpha,
      across(
        .cols = c(nSets, nperm, maxSetSize),
        .fns = ~ scales::comma_format()(.x)
      ),
      across(
        .cols = c(nperm, nSamples, maxSetSize, nSets),
        .fns = ~ factor(.x, levels = unique(.x))
      ),
      maxSetSize = as.character(maxSetSize),
      maxSetSize2 = ifelse(
        nSamples == levels(nSamples)[1L] &
          maxSetSize == unique(maxSetSize)[1L],
        "x",
        maxSetSize
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      maxSetSize2 = factor(maxSetSize2,
        levels = c("x", unique(maxSetSize)),
        labels = c(
          paste0(
            "Max. set size = ",
            unique(maxSetSize)[1L]
          ),
          unique(maxSetSize)
        )
      ),
      maxSetSize = maxSetSize2,
      maxSetSize2 = NULL
    )

  levels(x$nSamples)[1] <- paste0("N samples = ", levels(x$nSamples)[1])

  return(x)
}
```

```{r fun-plot-time}
# Format number of seconds as minutes and seconds (min:sec)
as_ms <- function(x) {
  m <- floor(x / 60)
  s <- x - (m * 60)

  sprintf("%02g:%02g", m, s)
}

plot_time <- function(x, y_breaks) {
  p <- ggplot(x, aes(
    x = x_pos,
    y = elapsed_time,
    color = nSets
  )) +
    geom_point(
      shape = 3,
      size = 1.05,
      stroke = 0.8
    ) +
    # ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(~ nSamples + maxSetSize,
    facet_wrap(~ maxSetSize,
      # nest_line = element_line(
      #   color = "black",
      #   linewidth = 0.25,
      #   linetype = 1,
      #   lineend = "square"
      # ),
      # resect = unit(8, "pt"),
      drop = TRUE,
      nrow = 1L
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("0.0", "1.0"),
      expand = expansion(add = 0.2)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = y_breaks,
      limits = c(0, max(c(y_breaks, x$elapsed_time))),
      # labels = as_ms,
      sec.axis = sec_axis(
        transform = function(x) x,
        name = latex2exp::TeX(
          paste0("$\\pi$ = ", unique(x$nperm))
        )
      ),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Number of\ngene sets",
      # values = c("grey86", "grey48", "black"),
      # values = c("grey75", "black", "#0070cc"),
      values = palette.colors(n = 3L),
      breaks = c("1,000", "10,000", "50,000")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = latex2exp::TeX("$\\alpha$"),
      # y = "Runtime (min:sec)"
      y = "Runtime (seconds)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = rel(0.9)),
      axis.ticks = element_line(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.35
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.text.y.right = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y.right = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        fill = NA,
        color = "black"
      ),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
        color = "grey95",
        linewidth = 0.35
      ),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(
        color = "grey95",
        linewidth = 0.35
      ),
      panel.spacing.x = unit(2, units = "pt"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 7)
    )

  return(p)
}
```

```{r timing-ssgsea}
# Fast-ssGSEA
time_res <- prepare_data("../data/fast-ssGSEA_timing_results.rds")

# 10,000 permutations
pa <- filter(desktop, nperm == "10,000") %>%
  plot_time(y_breaks = seq(0, 6, 1))

# 100,000 permutations
pb <- filter(desktop, nperm == "100,000") %>%
  plot_time(y_breaks = seq(0, 10, 2))

# 1,000,000 permutations
pc <- filter(desktop, nperm == "1,000,000") %>%
  plot_time(y_breaks = seq(0, 55, 10))

# Combine plots
p <- ggarrange(
  pa, pb, pc,
  labels = c("A", "B", "C"),
  font.label = list(
    face = "bold"
  ),
  ncol = 1L,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "right", 
  vjust = 1.2
)

ggsave(
  filename = "../figures/figure-1.pdf",
  plot = p, height = 6, width = 4.5,
  bg = "white", dpi = 300
)

# For package README
ggsave(
  filename = "../../man/figures/README-figure-1.png",
  plot = p, height = 6, width = 4.5,
  bg = "white", dpi = 450
)
```
